title: Comparison of a row augmentation with a bounded-below total complex
statement: Let K be an integer cochain bicomplex in an abelian category with countable coproducts, with K^{p,q}=0 for p<0 or q<N [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let A be strictly bounded below by N, let a:A to K^0 be a chain map annihilated by the outgoing horizontal differential, and let b:A to Tot(K) have degree-n component a^n followed by the (0,n) total inclusion. If the row maps from the single-column bicomplex on A induced by a are quasi-isomorphisms, then b is a quasi-isomorphism.

proof.text: Make a the map from the single column at zero. Its source has the same lower bounds, and its row maps are quasi-isomorphisms by hypothesis. Apply bounded-below row comparison.

Construct the isomorphism from A to the total of its single-column bicomplex using singleColumnObjTotalXIso in each degree. Its chain relation follows because the horizontal differential is zero and the vertical sign in column zero is 1. The composite with the total map equals b componentwise; thus b is a quasi-isomorphism.

theorem quasiIso_of_boundedBelow_row_augmentation
    (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (up ℤ) (up ℤ)) (A : CochainComplex C ℤ) (N : ℤ)
    [A.IsStrictlyGE N]
    (hK : ∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ q < N → IsZero ((K.X p).X q))
    (a : A ⟶ K.X 0) (ha : ∀ p, (up ℤ).Rel 0 p → a ≫ K.d 0 p = 0)
    (b : A ⟶ K.total (up ℤ))
    (hb : ∀ n : ℤ, b.f n = a.f n ≫ K.ιTotal (up ℤ) 0 n n (by simp))
    (hrow : ∀ n : ℤ, QuasiIso
      (((flipFunctor C (up ℤ) (up ℤ)).map (mkHomFromSingle a ha)).f n)) :
    QuasiIso b
